## Description

<!-- SECTION:DESCRIPTION:BEGIN -->
Seen once on GCE (Linux, perf batch 1's correctness run, 2026-10-20): extent_store::shuttle needs_closes_to_wait_for_writers ran 37 s and failed; its stderr ends with 'test panicked in task Tried to get ExecutionState, but got the following error: NotSet' and a failing schedule string. Locally (macOS) it passes in 0.4-0.7 s, 3 of 3. fails_without catches the run's panic and forgets its payload, but a panic outside a Shuttle run (a drop of a Shuttle object after the run, or a task torn down mid-panic) escapes. The schedule string is in the run's fxdax-tests.log (/var/folders/.../fxdax-gce.9SjIzx); shuttle::replay reproduces it.
<!-- SECTION:DESCRIPTION:END -->
